snp4.7:1.1: TISSAMETTEYYASUTTAṂ. "Methunam anuyuttassa icc-āyasmā Tisso Metteyyo vighātaṃ brūhi {mārisa}, sutvāna tava sāsanaṃ viveke sikkhissāmase". || ||
snp4.7:2.1: "Methunam anuyuttassa Metteyyā ti Bhagavā mussat' evāpi sāsanaṃ, micchā ca paṭipajjati, etaṃ tasmiṃ anāriyaṃ. || ||
snp4.7:3.1: Eko pubbe caritvāna methunaṃ yo nisevati, yānaṃ bhantaṃ va taṃ loke hīnam āhu putujjanaṃ. || ||
snp4.7:4.1: Yaso kitti ca yā pubbe, hāyat' evāpi tassa sā, etam pi disvā sikkhetha methunaṃ vippahātave. || ||
snp4.7:5.1: Saṃkappehi pareto so kapaṇo viya jhāyati, sutvā paresaṃ nigghosaṃ maṃku hoti tathāvidho. || ||
snp4.7:6.1: Atha satthāni Kurute paravādehi codito, esa khv-assa mahāgedho: mosavajjaṃ pagāhati. || ||
snp4.7:7.1: Paṇḍito ti samaññāto ekacariyaṃ adhiṭṭhito, athāpi methune yutto mando va parikissati. || ||
snp4.7:8.1: Etam ādīnavaṃ ñatvā muni pubbāpare idha ekacariyaṃ daḷhaṃ kayirā, na nisevetha methunaṃ. || ||
snp4.7:9.1: Vivekaṃ yeva sikkhetha, *etad ariyānam* uttamaṃ, #tena seṭṭho na# maññetha, sa ve nibbānasantike. || ||
snp4.7:10.1: Rittassa munino carato kāmesu anapekhino oghatiṇṇassa pihayanti kāmesu gathitā pajā" ti. || || TISSAMETTEYYASUTTAṂ
